notes: Image 2 now offers six templates: the three layouts plus a no-text version of each.
Each layout adds small transparent props in the corners (plant, books, cup, towel, tray), kept under 30 percent of the product area so nothing covers the product.
The caption can be placed bottom right, bottom left or bottom centre.
Background blur is now applied automatically per layout and can be toggled off.
When generating, the image 2 layout is chosen automatically from the product category.
